description: Which Telegraph miner to trust for an intent, from an open on-chain record (EAS on Ethereum Sepolia) of how each miner's paid answers held up against independent truth: right, wrong, unusable, wrong place, abstained. Ranked by the Wilson lower bound of accuracy. Anyone can add evidence to the same schema.

intent.description: Exact intent name. Omit to list the intents with evidence.
